newsitem.title: USA: NY/NJ Port Authority boosts Newark payment - paper.
newsitem.headline: NY/NJ Port Authority boosts Newark payment - paper.

text.p: Port Authority of New York and New Jersey raised by $7 million lease payments to Newark, N.J., for Newark International Airport, reflecting a sharp rise in passengers, the Star Ledger reported Wednesday.

Port Authority said it sent $28 million to the city, a payment in lieu of taxes for its airport property. The figure was $10 million above the minimum payment required under an agreement with the city.

Newark officials attributed the increase to their recent threats of a lawsuit challenging the way the agency calculates its lease obligations, the newspaper said. But agency officials said it was strictly a result of increased passenger traffic.
